title: Security Deposit Interest Rate and Crediting Terms
content:
Cash held as a Security Deposit earns simple interest at the annual rate set by the Commission for the year. The rate, the crediting term and the holding period are the same for every kind.

| Security Deposit kind | Simple annual interest rate on cash deposits | When interest is credited | Months a cash deposit must be held before any interest is paid |
|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 4.17% (0.0417) | Simple interest credited to the deposit on each anniversary of the fully secured date, and pro rata to the day at refund or application | 6 |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | 4.17% (0.0417) | Same as above | 6 |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | 4.17% (0.0417) | Same as above | 6 |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 4.17% (0.0417) | Same as above | 6 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 4.17% (0.0417) | Same as above | 6 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 4.17% (0.0417) | Same as above | 6 |

## Notes

- The rate is a simple annual rate expressed as a decimal fraction (0.0417) or a percentage (4.17%); it is the rate the Commission sets for the year.
- The holding term is a count of months: a cash deposit must have been held 6 months before any interest is paid on it.
- The crediting term ties full-year crediting to the anniversary of the date the Security Deposit became fully secured, and part-year crediting to the day of refund or application.

## Questions on this schedule

**Does a business Security Deposit earn a different rate from a residential one?**
No. Every kind in the schedule shows the same rate, 4.17%.

**Is the holding term counted from the assessment date?**
The schedule counts months the cash deposit has been held, and the crediting term counts anniversaries from the fully secured date, not from the assessment date.
